124	func cmdMatrix(args []string) int {
125		fs := flagSet("matrix")
126		workDir := fs.String("work-dir", "", "Repository root (default: cwd)")
127		subset := fs.String("subset", "", "TerminalBench subset manifest (default: scripts/beadbench/external/termbench-subset-canary.json)")
128		profilesCSV := fs.String("profiles", "", "Comma-separated benchmark profile ids")
129		harnessesCSV := fs.String("harnesses", "fiz,pi,opencode", "Comma-separated harness adapter names")
130		reps := fs.Int("reps", 3, "Repetitions per harness/profile/task")
131		budgetUSD := fs.Float64("budget-usd", 0, "Matrix budget in USD (0 = no cap)")
132		out := fs.String("out", "", "Output directory (default: benchmark-results/matrix-<timestamp> under work-dir)")
133		resume := fs.Bool("resume", false, "Skip terminal reports already present under --out")
134		forceRerun := fs.Bool("force-rerun", false, "Rerun every tuple even when a terminal report exists")
135		retryBudgetHalted := fs.Bool("retry-budget-halted", false, "Rerun budget_halted reports while resuming")
136		perRunBudgetUSD := fs.Float64("per-run-budget-usd", 0, "Per-run budget cap in USD (0 = no per-run cap)")
137		tasksDir := fs.String("tasks-dir", "", "Path to TB-2 tasks directory; when set, harbor run is used for grading")
138		jobs := fs.Int("jobs", 1, "Number of tuple runs to execute concurrently (default: 1)")
139		if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
140			return 2
141		}
142		if *reps <= 0 {
143			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --reps must be > 0\n", benchCommandName())
144			return 2
145		}
146		if *profilesCSV == "" {
147			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles is required\n", benchCommandName())
148			return 2
149		}
150		if *harnessesCSV == "" {
151			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --harnesses is required\n", benchCommandName())
152			return 2
153		}
154	
155		wd := resolveWorkDir(*workDir)
156		subsetPath := *subset
157		if subsetPath == "" {
158			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, defaultMatrixSubset)
159		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(subsetPath) {
160			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, subsetPath)
161		}
162		outDir := *out
163		if outDir == "" {
164			outDir = filepath.Join(wd, "benchmark-results", "matrix-"+time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405Z"))
165		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(outDir) {
166			outDir = filepath.Join(wd, outDir)
167		}
168	
169		profileIDs := splitCSV(*profilesCSV)
170		harnesses := splitCSV(*harnessesCSV)
171		if len(profileIDs) == 0 || len(harnesses) == 0 {
172			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles and --harnesses must not be empty\n", benchCommandName())
173			return 2

206		// Build the full list of tuples to run.
207		type tupleSpec struct {
208			harness string
209			prof    *profile.Profile
210			rep     int
211			task    termbenchSubsetEntry
212		}
213		var tuples []tupleSpec
214		for _, harness := range harnesses {
215			for _, prof := range profiles {
216				for rep := 1; rep <= *reps; rep++ {
217					for _, task := range subsetData.Tasks {

230			report  matrixRunReport
231			skipped bool
232			err     error
233		}
234	
235		results := make([]tupleResult, len(tuples))
236		sem := make(chan struct{}, concurrency)
237	
238		var (
239			mu              sync.Mutex
240			accumulatedCost float64
241			firstErr        error
242		)
243	
244		var wg sync.WaitGroup
245		for i, spec := range tuples {
246			wg.Add(1)
247			go func(i int, spec tupleSpec) {
248				defer wg.Done()
249				sem <- struct{}{}
250				defer func() { <-sem }()

252				mu.Lock()
253				cost := accumulatedCost
254				mu.Unlock()
255	
256				report, skipped, err := runMatrixTuple(matrixTupleOptions{
257					workDir:           wd,

268					retryBudgetHalted: *retryBudgetHalted,
269					tasksDir:          resolvedTasksDir,
270					harborBin:         harborBin,
271				})
272	
273				mu.Lock()
274				results[i] = tupleResult{report, skipped, err}
275				if err != nil && firstErr == nil {
276					firstErr = err
277				}
278				if err == nil && !skipped {

283		}

288			return 1

299		output := matrixOutput{

303			Harnesses:       harnesses,
304			Reps:            *reps,
305			BudgetUSD:       *budgetUSD,
306			PerRunBudgetUSD: *perRunBudgetUSD,
307			Runs:            runs,
308			Cells:           summarizeMatrixCells(runs),
309			Notes: []string{

311				"adapter_module records the Python adapter path passed by the runner for the harness cell.",
312			},
313		}

315		if err := writeJSONAtomic(matrixPath, output); err != nil {
316			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: write matrix.json: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
317			return 1
318		}

320		return 0

405					jobName:   fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-rep%d", opts.harness, opts.task.ID, opts.rep),
406					repoRoot:  opts.workDir,
407				})
408				if err != nil {
409					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
410					report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
411					report.Error = err.Error()
412				} else {
413					report.ExitCode = harborResult.exitCode
414					report.Error = harborResult.errText
415					seconds := harborResult.wallSeconds
416					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
417					if harborResult.reward != nil {
418						report.Reward = harborResult.reward
419						report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
420						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
421					} else if harborResult.exitCode != 0 {
422						report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
423						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
424					} else {
425						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
426						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
427					}
428				}
429			}
430		} else {
431			result, err := runMatrixAdapter(opts.workDir, report.AdapterModule, opts.profile, matrixPrompt(opts.task), opts.task.ID, workDir)
432			if err != nil {
433				report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
434				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
435				report.Error = err.Error()
436			} else {
437				report.Command = result.Command.Argv
438				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Apply.Notes...)
439				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Command.Notes...)
440				report.ExitCode = result.ExitCode
441				if result.ExitCode != 0 {
442					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
443					report.Error = strings.TrimSpace(result.Stderr)
444				}
445				applyTelemetry(&report, result.Telemetry)
446				if report.WallSeconds == nil && result.Duration >= 0 {
447					seconds := float64(result.Duration) / 1000
448					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
449				}
450			}
451		}
452		if report.ProcessOutcome == "" {
453			report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
454		}
455		if report.GradingOutcome == "" {
456			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
457		}
458		if report.Reward != nil && report.GradingOutcome == "ungraded" {
459			report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
460		}
461		report.CostUSD = matrixCostUSD(opts.profile, report)
462		if (opts.perRunBudgetUSD > 0 && report.CostUSD > opts.perRunBudgetUSD) ||
463			(opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost+report.CostUSD > opts.budgetUSD) {
464			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
465			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
466			report.Reward = nil
467		}
468		report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, report.Retriable)
469		report.InvalidClass = classifyMatrixInvalid(report)
470		report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
471		if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
472			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
473		}
474		return report, false, nil
475	}

787	func acquireMatrixLock(path string) (func(), error) {
788		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o750); err != nil {
789			return nil, err
790		}
791		lock := matrixLock{PID: os.Getpid(), StartedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
792		raw, _ := json.Marshal(lock)
793		for attempts := 0; attempts < 2; attempts++ {
794			f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600) // #nosec G304 -- path is the matrix lock file path
795			if err == nil {
796				if _, werr := f.Write(raw); werr != nil {
797					_ = f.Close()
798					_ = os.Remove(path)
799					return nil, werr
800				}
801				if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
802					_ = os.Remove(path)
803					return nil, err
804				}
805				return func() { _ = os.Remove(path) }, nil
806			}
807			if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
808				return nil, err
809			}
810			existing, readErr := readMatrixLock(path)
811			if readErr == nil && !processAlive(existing.PID) {
812				if removeErr := os.Remove(path); removeErr != nil && !errors.Is(removeErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
813					return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove stale lock %s: %w", path, removeErr)
814				}
815				continue
816			}
817			pid := "unknown"
818			if readErr == nil && existing.PID > 0 {
819				pid = strconv.Itoa(existing.PID)
820			}
821			return nil, fmt.Errorf("matrix tuple locked by pid %s: %s", pid, path)
822		}
823		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not acquire matrix tuple lock: %s", path)
824	}

931		type acc struct {
932			cell          matrixCell
933			rewards       []float64
934			invalidCounts map[string]int
935			cost          float64
936			inputTokens   int
937			outputTokens  int
938			cachedTokens  int
939			retriedTokens int
940		}
941		byKey := map[string]*acc{}
942		for _, run := range runs {
943			key := run.Harness + "\x00" + run.ProfileID
944			a := byKey[key]
945			if a == nil {
946				a = &acc{cell: matrixCell{Harness: run.Harness, ProfileID: run.ProfileID}}
947				byKey[key] = a
948			}
949			a.cell.NRuns++
950			if invalidClass := classifyMatrixInvalid(run); invalidClass != "" {
951				a.cell.NInvalid++
952				if a.invalidCounts == nil {
953					a.invalidCounts = map[string]int{}
954				}
955				a.invalidCounts[invalidClass]++
956			} else {
957				a.cell.NValid++
958				if run.Reward != nil {
959					a.cell.NReported++
960					a.rewards = append(a.rewards, float64(*run.Reward))
961				}
962			}
963			a.cost += run.CostUSD
964			a.inputTokens += intValue(run.InputTokens)
965			a.outputTokens += intValue(run.OutputTokens)
966			a.cachedTokens += intValue(run.CachedInputTokens)
967			a.retriedTokens += intValue(run.RetriedInputTokens)
968		}
969		cells := make([]matrixCell, 0, len(byKey))
970		for _, a := range byKey {
971			a.cell.CostUSD = a.cost
972			a.cell.InputTokens = a.inputTokens
973			a.cell.OutputTokens = a.outputTokens
974			a.cell.CachedTokens = a.cachedTokens
975			a.cell.RetriedTokens = a.retriedTokens
976			a.cell.InvalidCounts = a.invalidCounts
977			if len(a.rewards) > 0 {
978				mean := mean(a.rewards)
979				sd := sampleSD(a.rewards, mean)
980				a.cell.MeanReward = &mean
981				a.cell.SDReward = &sd
982			}
983			cells = append(cells, a.cell)

1	# Fizeau Benchmark Scripts
2	
3	This directory contains scripts and config for running fiz under
4	Terminal-Bench/Harbor and capturing reproducible benchmark baselines.
5	
6	---
7	
8	## Prerequisites
9	
10	```bash
11	# Terminal-Bench dataset
12	harbor dataset pull terminal-bench/terminal-bench-2
13	
14	# Docker (local runtime)
15	docker info  # must succeed
16	```
17	
18	If `harbor` is not already installed, `smoke_run.sh` and `run_benchmark.sh`
19	now install it automatically with `uv tool install harbor`.
20	
21	---
22	
23	## Egress Canary (rig validation, before any new adapter work)
24	
25	`egress_canary.sh` proves in-container egress to a tool-capable smoke
26	provider before spending budget on full benchmarks or building new
27	adapters. It targets a single concrete TB-2 task (`fix-git` by default —
28	the bead-pinned canary; terminal-bench@2.0 has no `hello-world` task at
29	the pinned commit) and accepts an **egress signal** (trajectory.json with
30	≥ 1 step) as success. The verifier reward is recorded but is *not* part
31	of the gate, since smoke models routinely fail TB-2 tasks.
32	
33	```bash
34	OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-... ./scripts/benchmark/egress_canary.sh
35	```
36	
37	Output: `benchmark-results/egress-canary-<UTC-TIMESTAMP>/` containing the
38	trajectory, reward, a `trial/` symlink, and a `canary.json` summary.
39	
40	---
41	
42	## Smoke Run (adapter validation)
43	
44	Validates the Harbor adapter works end-to-end on a single task (~2 min).
45	
46	```bash
47	# With Anthropic API key
48	ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... ./scripts/benchmark/smoke_run.sh
49	
50	# With OpenRouter
51	OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-... ./scripts/benchmark/smoke_run.sh
52	```
53	
54	**Passing criterion**:
55	- fiz exits 0
56	- `trajectory.json` is valid JSON with ≥ 1 step
57	- `reward.txt` exists (0 or 1 — both valid for smoke)
58	
59	---
60	
61	## Full Benchmark Run (baseline capture)
62	
63	Runs the committed 15-task subset and emits a machine-readable report.
64	
65	```bash
66	ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... ./scripts/benchmark/run_benchmark.sh
67	```
68	
69	The report is written to `benchmark-results/report-<TIMESTAMP>.json` and
70	contains git SHA, agent version, model, provider, per-task outcomes, and
71	the aggregate resolved-task rate.
72	
73	### Commit-independent runs
74	
75	You can point the same harness at a prebuilt fiz binary instead of
76	rebuilding the current checkout:
77	
78	```bash
79	FIZEAU_BENCH_BINARY=/path/to/fiz-linux-amd64 \
80	FIZEAU_BENCH_SHA=<commit-under-test> \
81	./scripts/benchmark/run_benchmark.sh
82	```
83	
84	This is the required path for evidence-grade before/after comparison across
85	multiple agent SHAs.
86	
87	### Dry-run harness validation
88	
89	Use dry-run mode to validate the staged binary/config and recorded metadata
90	without invoking Harbor:
91	
92	```bash
93	FIZEAU_BENCH_DRY_RUN=1 \
94	FIZEAU_BENCH_BINARY=/path/to/fiz-linux-amd64 \
95	FIZEAU_MODEL=qwen/qwen3.6-plus \
96	./scripts/benchmark/run_benchmark.sh
97	```
98	
99	### Comparing two baselines
100	
101	```bash
102	# Capture baseline before a change
103	ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... ./scripts/benchmark/run_benchmark.sh
104	# ... make changes ...
105	# Capture new run
106	ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... ./scripts/benchmark/run_benchmark.sh

108	# Compare (jq example)

136	## Evidence Workflow
137	
138	The benchmark evidence pipeline is:
139	
140	1. Run a benchmark job and keep the raw artifacts in `benchmark-results/`.
141	2. Import the resulting run, report, or curated snapshot into JSONL evidence.
142	3. Validate the imported evidence and append it to an append-only ledger.
143	4. Generate benchmark-specific or cross-benchmark claims from the ledger.
144	
145	The canonical operator loop for a TerminalBench matrix is:
146	
147	```bash
148	# 1) produce raw matrix artifacts
149	OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-... \
150	  scripts/benchmark/run_medium_model_terminalbench_comparison.sh canary
151	
152	# 2) project raw matrix artifacts into normalized evidence
153	go run ./cmd/bench evidence import-terminalbench --matrix <matrix-dir> --out benchmark-results/evidence/terminalbench.jsonl
154	
155	# 3) validate and append to the ledger
156	go run ./cmd/bench evidence validate benchmark-results/evidence/terminalbench.jsonl
157	go run ./cmd/bench evidence append --in benchmark-results/evidence/terminalbench.jsonl --ledger benchmark-results/evidence/ledger.jsonl
158	
159	# 4) emit benchmark claims from the ledger
160	go run ./cmd/bench fhi delta --ledger benchmark-results/evidence/ledger.jsonl --left <record_id> --right <record_id>
161	go run ./cmd/bench fhi rank --ledger benchmark-results/evidence/ledger.jsonl
162	```
163	
164	This workflow is anchored by [SD-012](../../docs/helix/02-design/solution-designs/SD-012-benchmark-evidence-ledger.md)
165	and the benchmark resource notes for
166	[Rapid-MLX MHI](../../docs/resources/rapid-mlx-mhi-2026-05-06.md),
167	[SkillsBench](../../docs/resources/skillsbench-2026-05-06.md),
168	[SWE-bench](../../docs/resources/swebench-2026-05-06.md), and
169	[HumanEval](../../docs/resources/humaneval-2026-05-06.md).
170	
171	Beadbench enters the same ledger path through `evidence import-beadbench` from
172	its `report.json` output, and curated external snapshots enter through
173	`evidence import-external`. For a concrete beadbench source-run example, see
174	[the OMLX Qwen reasoning sweep note](../../docs/research/beadbench-omlx-qwen-reasoning-sweep-2026-04-24.md).
175	
176	Use the command family below for the full evidence loop:
177	
178	- `go run ./cmd/bench evidence import-terminalbench`
179	- `go run ./cmd/bench evidence import-beadbench`
180	- `go run ./cmd/bench evidence import-external`
181	- `go run ./cmd/bench evidence validate`
182	- `go run ./cmd/bench evidence append`
183	- `go run ./cmd/bench fhi delta`
184	- `go run ./cmd/bench fhi rank`

186	### 1. Run benchmark jobs
187	
188	Use the TerminalBench runners to produce the raw matrix or report artifacts:
189	
190	```bash
191	# Harness comparison matrix
192	BASELINE=local TIER=wide REPS=1 FORCE_RERUN=1 JOBS=1 \
193	  scripts/benchmark/run_vidar_qwen36_terminalbench_baseline.sh
194	
195	# Compact native-vs-fiz comparison wrapper

197	  scripts/benchmark/run_medium_model_terminalbench_comparison.sh canary
198

200	ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... ./scripts/benchmark/run_benchmark.sh
201	```
202	
203	Those scripts write their raw outputs under `benchmark-results/`, which stays
204	gitignored. Large logs, model outputs, tarballs, and upstream artifacts belong
205	there, not in git.
206	
207	### 2. Import benchmark evidence
208	
209	Project the source artifacts into normalized JSONL evidence with the bench CLI:
210	
211	```bash
212	go run ./cmd/bench evidence import-terminalbench \
213	  --matrix cmd/bench/testdata/terminalbench-matrix \
214	  --out benchmark-results/evidence/terminalbench.jsonl
215	
216	go run ./cmd/bench evidence import-beadbench \
217	  --report cmd/bench/testdata/beadbench-report/report.json \
218	  --out benchmark-results/evidence/beadbench.jsonl
219	
220	go run ./cmd/bench evidence import-external \
221	  --source cmd/bench/testdata/external-benchmarks/rapid-mlx-mhi.md \
222	  --out benchmark-results/evidence/external.jsonl
223	```
224	
225	`import-terminalbench` is the path for Harbor matrix outputs, `import-beadbench`
226	is the path for beadbench `report.json`, and `import-external` is the path for
227	curated external benchmark snapshots, including Rapid-MLX MHI, SkillsBench,
228	SWE-bench, and HumanEval fixtures. Beadbench and other local runs enter the
229	ledger through their importer paths, not by hand-editing the schema.
230	
231	Raw benchmark artifacts remain in the gitignored `benchmark-results/` tree.
232	Only curated snapshots or source hashes that have been normalized into ledger
233	records should be committed. This repo currently keeps importer fixtures in
234	`cmd/bench/testdata/external-benchmarks/` and `cmd/bench/testdata/fhi/`.
235	Approved checked-in curated snapshots, if added later, should live under
236	`scripts/benchmark/evidence/<snapshot-id>.jsonl`.

238	### 3. Validate and append to the ledger
239	
240	```bash
241	go run ./cmd/bench evidence validate benchmark-results/evidence/terminalbench.jsonl
242	go run ./cmd/bench evidence append \
243	  --in benchmark-results/evidence/terminalbench.jsonl \
244	  --ledger benchmark-results/evidence/ledger.jsonl
245	```
246	
247	Append-only ledgers keep the normalized records and their source hashes or
248	source URLs together. Checked-in curated snapshots, when approved, live under
249	`scripts/benchmark/evidence/<snapshot-id>.jsonl` and must contain normalized
250	records only. Raw artifacts stay in `benchmark-results/`; curated snapshots or
251	source hashes are the committed evidence.

253	### 4. Generate FHI claims
254	
255	Use `go run ./cmd/bench fhi delta` for pairwise benchmark claims and
256	`go run ./cmd/bench fhi rank` for cross-benchmark FHI rankings:
257	
258	```bash
259	go run ./cmd/bench fhi delta \
260	  --ledger benchmark-results/evidence/ledger.jsonl \
261	  --left terminalbench-delta-left-opus-claude-code \
262	  --right terminalbench-delta-right-opus-claude-code
263	
264	go run ./cmd/bench fhi rank \
265	  --ledger benchmark-results/evidence/ledger.jsonl
266	```
267	
268	Pinned axes:
269	
270	- `fhi delta` compares only two records on the same benchmark axis. Keep the
271	  benchmark, subset, scorer, formula version, and denominator policy fixed;
272	  vary only the subject axis you are measuring.
273	- `fhi rank` compares subjects across the same evidence window and formula.
274	  Keep the included benchmark set fixed so local-stack rows and frontier rows
275	  are scored against the same ledger window.

277	Harness-vs-harness example:

279	```text

284	claude-code      81.7 ± 1.8
285	delta            -0.7
286	```

291	- same provider surface
292	- same benchmark version, dataset commit, and subset/version

344	
345	Harness-vs-harness claims must pin the benchmark axes and vary only the
346	harness. For a TerminalBench comparison, keep the model, provider, benchmark
347	version, subset id/version, scorer, evidence window, denominator policy, and
348	run environment fixed while comparing two harness rows such as `fiz-native`
349	and `claude-code`.
350	
351	Example harness-vs-harness claim:
352	
353	```text
354	FHI formula=fhi/v1, evidence window=2026-Q2
355	benchmarks=terminal-bench tb2-wide@<dataset_commit>
356	model=Opus 4.7
357	provider=anthropic
358	
359	fiz-native     81.0 ± 2.1
360	claude-code    81.7 ± 1.8
361	delta         -0.7
362	```

364	Pinned axes:
365	
366	- formula version
367	- evidence window
368	- benchmark name, version, dataset commit, subset id, subset version, and scorer
369	- model raw name and canonical model id when known
370	- provider name and provider surface
371	- denominator rule and run environment
372	- only the harness row changes

375	benchmark set, and denominator rules on both sides. The local row also needs the

377	
378	- runtime/server name and version
379	- model artifact id or checksum when available

382	- endpoint type and provider surface
